Dear {{greeting_name}},

I am writing to apply for the {{role}} position at {{company}}. I am an AI engineer who builds production LLM systems, and I would like to bring that experience to your team.

Most recently I architected a hybrid retrieval platform over 1.7M+ legal documents — Pinecone semantic search and MongoDB keyword search behind adaptive routing, with a Cohere-reranked two-stage retrieval layer fed by an event-driven vectorization pipeline (SQS workers, OCR, semantic chunking). Before that I built a HubSpot migration platform that moves 5,000+ CRM assets per run through a parallel n8n pipeline with idempotency checks and rate-limit handling.

Day to day I work with Python, PyTorch, LangChain, FastAPI, Docker and AWS, on top of a CS degree from FAST-NUCES Islamabad.

I would welcome the chance to talk about how I could contribute to {{company}}. My resume is attached.

Sincerely,
{{sender_name}}
